test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correctly spelt option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The goods were taken on a public __career__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**carrier.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Among the given options;
 
 
• **The word 'carrier' is the correct spelling for the underlined word in the sentence.**
 
 
 
• **It means a person or company that transports goods or people from one place to another.**(वाहक)
 
 
• Example: The instruments were sent by a carrier.
 
 
 
• Whereas, the word "career" means the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life.(व्यवसाय)
 
• The correct sentence will be: The goods were taken on a public carrier.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The spellings given in option 1 and 2 are incorrect.
 
• The word "courier" in option 4 means a person or company that delivers messages, packages, or mail.(संदेशवाहक)​
